name: Hotel Schiestl
beschreibung: The Hotel Schiestl is situated in the quiet village of Fügenberg, above Fügen in the Zillertal valley. As a traditional family-run hotel, it offers alpine furnishings with characteristic Tyrolean charm. Guests can enjoy a generous wellness area with sauna and swimming pool. In winter, the hotel is conveniently located near the Spieljoch and Hochfügen ski areas. The half-board package includes regional dishes from breakfast to dinner. The quiet hillside location also provides sweeping views across the valley and makes for a restful stay.
